Access Opcode

group FIRMWARE_DISTRIBUTION_ACCESS_OPCODE

Mesh message access opcode definitions.

Defines

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_RECVS_ADD 0x8311

Add firmware distribution receivers.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_RECVS_DELETE_ALL 0x8312

Delete all firmware distribution receivers.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_RECVS_STATUS 0x8313

Get status of receivers in firmware distribution.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_RECVS_GET 0x8314

Get receivers in firmware distribution.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_RECVS_LIST 0x8315

List receivers in firmware distribution.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_CAPS_GET 0x8316

Get firmware distribution capabilities.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_CAPS_STATUS 0x8317

Get status of firmware distribution capabilities.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_GET 0x8318

Get firmware distribution status.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_START 0x8319

Start firmware distribution process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_SUSPEND 0x831A

Suspend firmware distribution process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_CANCEL 0x831B

Cancel firmware distribution process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_APPLY 0x831C

Apply firmware distribution updates.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_STATUS 0x831D

Status of firmware distribution process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_UPLOAD_GET 0x831E

Get firmware upload status.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_UPLOAD_START 0x831F

Start firmware upload process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_UPLOAD_OOB_START 0x8320

Start out-of-band firmware upload.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_UPLOAD_CANCEL 0x8321

Cancel firmware upload process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_UPLOAD_STATUS 0x8322

Status of firmware upload process.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_FW_GET 0x8323

Get firmware information.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_FW_GET_BY_INDEX 0x8324

Get firmware information by index.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_FW_DELETE 0x8325

Delete firmware image.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_FW_DELETE_ALL 0x8326

Delete all firmware images.

MESH_MSG_FW_DIST_FW_STATUS 0x8327

Status of firmware in distribution.
